for: tools/world-shaders.mjs (NT): the LIFE and BASES GLSL programs, read from the pinned src/realm/life.js programs() and bases.js load(). All eleven are in the export at the pin (renderer/src/main/resources/world/shaders/index.json, WorldShaders.realm); NT merges this list for the record and the lane-list check. Stage B (205b6326): life-scatter compiles with defines { LIFE_GLOW: 1 }, so its export key is life-scatter+LIFE_GLOW=1 (the program count stays eleven). Also lists the pack files the N3 debug bundle must carry for these lanes (world-debug-content.mjs selection()).

includes.registeredBy: life.js createLife(): core.include('life', LIFE); bases.js: none of its own
includes.classes: GROUND's glsl/classes.glsl.js CLASSES (every LIFE program; BASES programs read no terrain, P0)

programs.name: life-scatter
programs.why: life.js programs() at 205b6326 (stage B, 69fb02c2/39bd2ebc): the only LIFE program with LIFE_GLOW, so only SCATTER_VS writes vGlow and SPRITE_FS reads it (the map-object lens glow); the other SPRITE_FS programs compile without it
states: sprite: depth LEQUAL, writes on, blend off (uMode 0 kit art, 2 twins)
air: depth off, blend off (uMode 1 emitter puffs)

programs.name: life-creature
programs.why: GPU_SAFE.rehearse.trueSet is ['rm-true'] at the pin: life-creature draws MAP herds from BANDS.herds 300, so it is MAP set

programs.name: life-bird
states: shadow: depth off, writes off, blend DST_COLOR/ZERO (ground shadows)

programs.name: bases-sprite
states: sprite: depth LEQUAL, writes on, blend off (minis, icons, keeps, TRUE decor)
smoke: depth LEQUAL, writes off, blend ONE/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA
programs.rehearsalNote: bases.js REHEARSAL: two instances (the magnified textureLod path and the minified texture() path)

programs.name: bases-shield
states: shieldBack: depth off, writes off, blend over (back shell, selection pulse)
shieldFront: depth LEQUAL, writes off, blend over

programs.name: bases-fx
states: pennant: depth LEQUAL, writes on, blend off
glow: depth LEQUAL, writes off, blend ONE/ONE

programs.name: bases-field
states: field (shadow pass): depth off, writes off, blend over

programs.name: bases-dot
states: dot (fx pass): depth off, writes off, blend over

content.why: LIFE reads the realm's sprite atlas (realm.json sprites + creatures), the map twins and map objects (mapkit.png) and the shared fx pack; BASES reads the shared keeps/decor atlases, the realm atlas (kit dressing, edge autotile, bridge pieces, creatures), the MAP minis (plots.webp) and the ROAD terrain's pure layers (the TRUE ground atlas). The N1/N2 debug bundle carries none of them (NT's selection()).
